'''Macroeconomics'''<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref> was a branch of [[Economics/Legends|economics]]<ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref> that studied economical cycles.<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20090910jc115|series=Jedi Counseling|text=115}}</ref> The [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]]<ref name="NEGTD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[BRT supercomputer/Legends|BRT supercomputer]]</ref> [[BRT supercomputer/Legends|BRT supercomputer]] [[AL-BRT-34-X3]], who, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] shortly following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], had been a part of the campus of the [[Calamar University]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] for 201 [[Standard year/Legends|years]], was proficient in macroeconomics.<ref name="CRO" /> Likewise, macroeconomics was a subject that [[CUTH-BRT-92-X3]], a BRT [[supercomputer]] who assisted with the operation of the [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] on<ref name="DarkStryder">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Death Is Remotely Possible|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Ott system]]</ref> planet [[Gandle Ott]], was proficient in.<ref name="DarkStryder" />

==Behind the scenes==
Macroeconomics was mentioned in ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a [[1994]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CRO" /> In the real world, [[Wikipedia:Macroeconomics|macroeconomics]] is a branch of [[Wikipedia:Economics|economics]] that studies the broad and general aspects of an [[Wikipedia:Economy|economy]].<ref name="Macroeconomics">{{WebCite|url=https://www.dictionary.com/browse/macroeconomics|text=MACROECONOMICS Definition & Meaning|work=[[Wikipedia:Dictionary.com|Dictionary.com, LLC]]|archivedate=20230922025921}}</ref>
